basis: Alice holds the hall_floor anchor (X 1.90 / Z 0.028) on the flagstones in front of the little door, facing -X into the wall face at X 1.24. She notices the low curtain at t=1.2, leans in and lifts it at t=3.0, crouches to the 0.38 m door at t=4.6 and is on her knees with both hands at the lock from sh040. The little door's clear opening is 0.26 x 0.38 m between the jambs at X 1.1875 and the curtain hangs on the hall face to y 0.6, so her kneeling body sits 0.36 m clear of the wall.
warnings: sh039's pedestal is a pure vertical 1.30 -> 0.90 m with the axis unchanged, held 1.6 s before and 3.2 s after, matching camera.json's 0.18 m/s.
Screen sides: both lenses look -X, so screen-right is -Z; Alice is offset to the -Z side of the axis and reads at about 0.72 (sh039) and 0.70 (sh040) of frame width, as composition requires.

issues.question: SCN-little-door-passage is modelled as a 5.0 x 2.81 m detail tile whose hall-side floor is only 1.26 m deep (X 1.24 to 2.50). sh039 needs 2.5 m of standoff and sh040 1.86 m, so both lenses stand 1.0-1.9 m beyond the tile's edge. Stage them outside the tile, or move these two shots onto the SCN-long-hall model where the same floor really exists?
issues.provisional: Place the lenses at the distance the size codes need, outside the modelled tile on the hall side. Nothing is modelled there, so nothing occludes and the geometry is correct; the whitebox simply shows floor running out behind the camera.

options.label: Keep the lens outside the detail tile (the default)
options.consequence: Correct framing and geometry; the spatial view shows the camera standing off the edge of the modelled ground plane.

options.label: Re-point grp015/grp016 at SCN-long-hall, whose west wall already carries the little door and curtain at (9.92, -3.33)
options.consequence: The lens stands on real modelled floor and the neighbouring hall doors are in frame at true spacing; needs a shot_list scene_id change, which is outside this station's authority.

options.label: Clamp the lens to the tile edge and accept a tighter frame
options.consequence: sh039 loses about half its frame height; a kneeling Alice no longer fits.

sources.quote: hall_floor: x 0.7475-1.0: open hall floor; the curtain hangs on the hall face in front of the little door.
standing then crouching, about 0.90 of frame height falling
